origin.description: The sum of the main diagonal of a square numeric matrix.
origin.details: A value that is not a matrix stops with "argument x is not a matrix". A matrix that is not square stops with "argument x is not a square matrix". The sum starts at 0, so a diagonal of -0 is +0. An integer or logical diagonal stays an integer while the sum fits in a 32-bit integer.
origin.value: One number, the sum of the diagonal.
